fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting focused on Miami and Florida public affairs, including advocacy for state takeover/public ownership of Florida Power & Light Company and discussion of taxation and state finances. Prominent coverage criticizes Miami police department leadership and city commission actions in the C. O. Huttoe case, with calls for grand jury investigation, and reports on court and crime items. Additional pieces address public welfare funding, federal regulation affecting prescription refills for sleeping pills, local civic issues, and community developments such as parks/playgrounds expansion and Florida oil drilling activity; includes letters to the editor and advertisements.
